english.title: Obstruct authorised person under the Microchipping of Cats and Dogs (England) Regulations 2023 regarding a dog - England
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) obstructed **(..SPECIFY AUTHORISED OFFICER..), an authorised officer, exercising a power under regulation 13 of the Microchipping of Cats and Dogs (England) Regulations 2023 in relation to a dog, namely **(..IDENTIFY DOG..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 13 and 14(2)(f) of the Microchipping of Cats and Dogs (England) Regulations 2023.
